title: Quran Study from Parivash 35: Sura 30, the Brewery Origin of the Miracle, Intercession, and Divine Control

cases.question: Which themes appear in Quran 30:25–32?
cases.expected_answer_note: The verses describe creation standing at God's disposal, immediate resurrection, the absurdity of sharing divine authority, natural instinct toward God alone, Contact Prayer, and rejection of sectarianism. Rashad connects them with the premortal test, Satan's challenge, mercy, and salvation before forty.

cases.question: How did Rashad move from Monsanto to Anheuser-Busch?
